sections.name: DECISION: May garments made through Kiln's copied job interface go into the game?
why: Ron's work trousers are the first Kiln garment heading for the game; adopting them waits on this.

Correction (18 Nov): Kiln's cloth engine is Drape Studio's, and 58 of its values and behaviours were taken by decompiling Marvelous. Earlier this item said only command names were reused; that was wrong.
sections.recommendation: Not yet: replace those 58 first (about 28 helper hours and 5 machine hours in all; Ron's trousers can be cleared first, in about 10 and 4). 22 turn out to be in Marvelous's public instructions; the rest Kiln redoes in its own way or by measuring. Then this comes back to you.
options: Not yet: replace the decompiled parts first (recommended)
Yes, adopt Kiln garments now as they are
No: Kiln garments reach the game only through Marvelous
